insight: Use sas_first to resolve bridge entities from oblique descriptors before causal reasoning.
applies_when: Query mentions roles, classes, or indirect descriptors like 'operator of X-class' or 'author of Y-series'.
avoid_when: Entity explicitly named; direct mapping obvious; causal chain trivial.

insight: Limit SAS to bridge; if no starring/lead evidence after one probe, escalate to MAS with cast-order verification.
applies_when: Question asks for lead actor or cast prominence.
avoid_when: Starring evidence is explicit from the first SAS probe.

insight: For belief about organization with indirect naming, prefer sas_first with at least two targeted hops; direct_mas guesses generically.
applies_when: Claims like 'Person believes X about Org' with alias, class, or descriptor instead of explicit org name.
avoid_when: Org named explicitly or prior knowledge makes MAS precise without SAS.

insight: Entity-to-state-to-standardized geo attribute: skip SAS; use direct_mas 2-hop with tight retrieval (2-3 docs per hop).
applies_when: Target is a standardized geographic attribute (e.g., area code, time zone) derivable via an entity-to-state hop; corpus has good coverage.
avoid_when: Jurisdiction is ambiguous, multiple candidate states exist, or attribute is non-standard/temporal; then probe with sas_first.

insight: Ambiguous names/homonyms: skip SAS; run direct_mas with a disambiguation hop before retrieving the target statistic or fact; If any compared name is ambiguous, skip SAS; run direct_mas with disambiguation and verify both.
applies_when: Entity names may refer to multiple people/places across countries; Two-person comparison and at least one name has homonyms or multiple cand
avoid_when: Entity is uniquely identified by context or known ID; Both names unique and dates verifiable via quick SAS

insight: Second hop targets another entity's influence within the style: skip SAS; run direct_mas 2-hop with verifier.
applies_when: Bridge asks influence-within-style about another entity; two fixed hops suffice.
avoid_when: Style is explicit or open-world evidence needed; not an influence relation.

insight: Add verifier to enforce answer type = subgenre-within-style for nested 'genre of style' questions; reject answers that are the style itself.
applies_when: Bridge asks for a subgenre within a style; risk of returning the style.
avoid_when: Single-hop genre lookups or when subtype typing is irrelevant.

insight: Unique org alias/history: skip sas_first; use direct_mas 2-hop (alias→entity, verify).
applies_when: Organization appears only via unique alias, former name, or historical descriptor; hops: alias→entity, entity→relation.
avoid_when: Alias is ambiguous or multiple candidates exist; or task is causal where a cheap SAS probe can help.

insight: Uniquely keyed film: skip SAS; use direct MAS with actor-type and lead-credit checks.
applies_when: Title is uniquely determined by provided descriptors.
avoid_when: Film or director remains ambiguous; run one SAS confirmation before MAS.

insight: Use sas_first with answer-type verifier for nationality/demonym; prefer brief lookup over direct_mas.
applies_when: Question asks nationality/demonym of a clearly named entity; evidence likely one-hop.
avoid_when: Entity ambiguous or multi-hop needed; then run direct_mas with disambiguation and verifier.

insight: For named people with single-hop facts, prefer one-hop sas_first; skip direct_mas unless answer-type verification is ensured.
applies_when: Named person; attribute like birth year, birthplace, occupation; no ambiguity.
avoid_when: Identity ambiguous or requires multi-hop synthesis; or answer-type verifier unavailable.

insight: After one SAS probe, continue only if both biographies’ dates are obtained; otherwise escalate to direct_mas.
applies_when: Two-person intersection or lifespan overlap questions.
avoid_when: Both dates are quickly retrieved via SAS within budget.

insight: Use sas_first only when both names are unambiguous and two SAS fetches with date checks fit budget; else use direct_mas.
applies_when: Two named people; compare lifespans/overlap and SAS budget allows two fetches.
avoid_when: Any name ambiguous or SAS budget insufficient for two verified date fetches.

insight: For unique film title release-year queries, prefer one-hop sas_first; ignore cast descriptors.
applies_when: Query seeks a film’s release year and the title is unique/unambiguous in major catalogs.
avoid_when: Title is ambiguous, has multiple localized releases with differing years, or SAS retrieval fails.

insight: Skip direct_mas when a single-hop temporal fact is reliably documented; MAS verbosity adds cost without gain.
applies_when: Temporal fact (e.g., film release year) is consistently present in canonical sources like Wikipedia infobox, IMDb, or studio site.
avoid_when: Fact is disputed, region-specific, or SAS is inconclusive.

insight: Verify SAS year via sas_verifier; escalate to direct_mas only on SAS failure or conflicting years.
applies_when: SAS returns a year with at least one reliable citation or snippet.
avoid_when: No SAS hit is obtained; skip verifier and proceed with MAS.
